name: National Governors Association Former Governors Search
license: Association website; verify reuse terms before redistribution
notes: Structured historical index with governor name, jurisdiction, party, years in office, and profile URL. The NGA is an association rather than a federal agency; treat this as a curated reference source and reconcile against state archives for authoritative completeness.

name: ACS 2023 5-Year State Profile Tables
notes: Keyless state-level extracts for B15003 education, B17001 poverty, B19013 household income, B25001 housing units, and B02001 race; margins of error are preserved.

name: ACS 2023 5-Year Table B01001 State Estimates
notes: State-level age-by-sex population estimates and margins of error extracted from the public table-based summary file without an API key.

name: ACS 2023 5-Year County Profile Tables
notes: Keyless county-level extracts for B01001, B15003, B17001, B19013, B25001, and B02001, preserving estimates and margins of error.

name: ACS 2023 5-Year Place Profile Tables
notes: Keyless place-level extracts for B01001, B19013, B25001, and B02001, preserving estimates and margins of error.

name: Open States People Bulk Repository

name: FEC 2024 Candidate Master File
license: U.S. government public data; follow FEC data-use restrictions
notes: Candidate IDs, names, party, election year, office, district, status, and principal committee linkage.

name: FEC 2024 Committee Master File
license: U.S. government public data; follow FEC data-use restrictions
notes: Federal committee identities, types, designations, party affiliations, filing frequency, connected organizations, and candidate linkage.

name: Official 2024 Presidential General Election Results
notes: Results compiled from official state and territory election offices; preserve the workbook's sheet and field structure.

name: Federal Elections 2022
notes: Official certified Senate and House primary/general results by state, candidate, party, and district.

name: ACS 2023 1-Year Congressional District Profile Tables

name: ACS 2023 5-Year Profile Variable Metadata

name: State Department Principal Officers and Chiefs of Mission
publisher: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian
notes: Retrospective biographies, roles, and service-year snippets across principal officers and chiefs of mission. The source documents explicit inclusion/exclusion rules and notes that database updates are suspended.

name: Secretaries of State - Principal Officers
publisher: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian
notes: Secretary names, service years, and biography links from 1790 to the present. The source notes that acting Secretaries designated during vacancies are excluded.

name: Biographical Directory of Article III Federal Judges, 1789-present
notes: Flat export of federal judge biographies, appointments, confirmations, court service, education, and professional careers. The source is updated nightly; retrieval manifests preserve the snapshot date.

name: Justices 1789 to Present
publisher: Supreme Court of the United States
notes: Historical chief and associate justice roster with state appointed from, appointing president, judicial oath date, and service termination date.

name: Alphabetical List of Vice Presidents and Their Terms
notes: Vice-presidential names, term years, and Library of Congress portrait-guide links.

name: Federal Register Presidential Memoranda and Determinations
notes: Keyless API collection of presidential memoranda, determinations, and other presidential documents, with official document links and agency metadata.

name: Federal Register Presidential Proclamations
notes: Presidential proclamation metadata with dates, titles, order numbers where available, abstracts, presidents, and official document links.

name: Federal Register Executive Orders
notes: Executive-order metadata and links to official HTML/JSON records; fetched with pagination and preserved with retrieval metadata.

name: American Community Survey 5-Year Profile
notes: Demographic, socioeconomic, household, housing, and population profile variables. The public API currently returns a missing-key response for data queries in this environment; use a Census API key or the downloadable summary files for ingestion.

name: Federal Register Agency Catalog
notes: Agency names, slugs, descriptions, parent/child relationships, and Federal Register publication metadata. Includes historical and component agencies represented in the Federal Register.

name: U.S. Presidents in the Census Records
notes: Chronological presidential service dates, including non-consecutive service as separate records.
